[00:00] HOST: This week we are at Hatch Lock with Dev Rao, the lock keeper.
[02:10] DEV: The cottage was built in 1849, the same year the lock was widened.
[05:30] HOST: How many boats come through on a summer Saturday?
[05:40] DEV: About ninety. The queue back to the bridge is normal by noon.
[08:50] DEV: The paddles need greasing every Monday, and I do it at seven.
[12:15] HOST: Do you ever get a quiet day?
[12:25] DEV: Tuesdays in February. I count the herons.
[15:00] HOST: Dev, thank you.
